description: Machine-readable upgrade backlog for the Forge Self-Upgrade Loop. Read by `pnpm forge:self-review`, which only analyzes and reports — it never changes code, commits, deploys or touches production.

upgrades.title: Evolution Scheduler operational
upgrades.description: The evolution scheduler must exist, be disabled by default, configurable via env, and expose GET/POST /evolution/scheduler.
acceptanceCriteria: Endpoints /evolution/scheduler are declared in the OpenAPI contract
testRequirements: Unit tests in api-server pass (pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run test)

upgrades.title: Self-analysis suite complete
upgrades.description: Quality, technical debt, dependency and architecture analysis must be available as API endpoints backed by real analyzers.
acceptanceCriteria: Analyzers exist for quality, debt, dependencies and architecture
GET /analysis/{quality,debt,dependencies,architecture} are declared in the OpenAPI contract

upgrades.title: Refactoring Engine feeds governance backlog
upgrades.description: Findings must become improvements that flow through the improvement→task→proposal→governance chain; the engine must never edit code directly.
acceptanceCriteria: Refactoring engine creates improvements only (no file writes outside sandboxes)
testRequirements: findingToImprovement mapping covered by unit tests

upgrades.title: Roadmap, Knowledge Base and Documentation Generator
upgrades.description: Forge must expose a generated roadmap, an internal knowledge base search and a self-model documentation generator.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /roadmap, GET /knowledge-base/search and POST /docs/generate exist in the contract
testRequirements: Smoke test through the local proxy (localhost:80/api)

upgrades.title: Concurrency-safe evolution loop
upgrades.description: Only one evolution run may execute at a time, enforced atomically at the database layer (advisory lock around check+insert).
acceptanceCriteria: Single-run guard uses a transaction with pg_advisory_xact_lock
Concurrent POST /evolution/run yields exactly one 201 and one 409
testRequirements: Manual/automated concurrency check: two simultaneous runs

upgrades.title: Self-review loop itself
upgrades.description: A local, read-only self-review workflow: machine-readable backlog, analysis runner and markdown report with an owner gate. Never commits, deploys or touches production.
acceptanceCriteria: pnpm forge:self-review runs locally and generates reports/forge-self-review.md
Runner fails when mandatory backlog fields are missing
